title: Developmental derivation of vocal fold mucosa from human induced pluripotent stem cells
protocol: When human iPS cell colonies reach 80% confluence, DE induction is performed.
Mix freshly RPMI medium/Glutamax with Activin A (100ng/ml) and Wnt 3a (25ng/ml).
Aspirate to remove mTesr1 medium, wash cells twice with RPMI medium/Glutamax to remove the rest of mTesr1 medium and add freshly prepared medium to the plate.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator overnight.
Mix freshly RPMI medium/Glutamax with Activin A (100ng/ml) and 0.2% FBS.
Aspirate to remove the old medium and add the freshly prepared medium to the plate.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator overnight.
Mix freshly RPMI medium/Glutamax with Activin A (100ng/ml) and 0.2% FBS.
Aspirate to remove the old medium and add the freshly prepared medium to the plate.
Mix DMEM/F12/Glutamax medium 500ml with 2% B12 (10ml), 1% N2 (5ml) and 1% P/S (1ml) to form DMEM/F12 basal medium. Keep it in the fridge for 8 weeks.
Dissolve 500 mg of l-ascorbic acid powder in 10 ml of water to make a 50 mg/ml solution.
Filter the ascorbic acid solution with a 0.22-µM filter.
Make 100-μl aliquots and store them at -20°C for up to 6 months.
Thaw stored aliquots at 4°C and use within 24 hours.
Mix freshly DMEM/F12 basal medium with ascorbic acid (0.05 mg/ml), 1-Thioglycerol (0.4 mM), Noggin (200 ng/ml) and SB-431542 (10 μM).
Aspirate to remove the old medium.
Add the freshly prepared medium to the plate.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator overnight.
Continue culturing AFE cells for an additional 3 days, by replacing the old medium with freshly prepared medium every day.
Mix freshly DMEM/F12 basal medium with ascorbic acid (0.05 mg/ml), 1-Thioglycerol (0.4 mM), FGF2 (250 ng/ml), FGF7 (100 ng/ml), and FGF10 (100 ng/ml).
Aspirate the old medium.
Replace it with freshly prepared medium.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator for 48 hours.
Meanwhile, prepare collagen-fibroblast constructs and conditional FAD medium.
Mix freshly DMEM basal medium with ascorbic acid (0.05 mg/ml), 1-Thioglycerol (0.4 mM), FGF2 (250 ng/ml), FGF7 (100 ng/ml), and FGF10 (100 ng/ml).
Collect and transfer the old medium from the culture plate into a 15 ml conical tube.
Filter the medium sterilely.
Digest cells with warm (0.025%, wt/vol) trypsin for 3 - 5 minutes.
Aspirate the trypsin.
Add the collected medium back to the wells.
Mechanically detach the cells with a 1,000-µl barrier tip or glass pipette.
Transfer cells to a new 15 ml conical tube (usually 2 wells at a time).
Wash the wells to collect remaining cells with freshly prepared medium.
Pipette the medium up and down and allow cells to settle for a few minutes or centrifuge cells briefly.
Aspirate gently to remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 100 μl of freshly prepared medium.
Re-plate the cells in 2x 50 μl volume on the top of collagen-fibroblast constructs.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator for 2 hours.
After 2 hours, flood the cells with new freshly prepared medium.
For one insert/well, add 1 ml of media into the upper chamber and 2 ml into the lower chamber.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator for 48 hours.
Mix conditional FAD medium with FGF2 (250 ng/ml), FGF7 (100 ng/ml), and FGF10 (100 ng/ml).
Aspire old medium from the upper and lower chambers.
Add freshly prepared conditional FAD medium to the plate.
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator for 48 hours.
Mix conditional FAD medium with FGF2 (250 ng/ml), FGF7 (100 ng/ml), and FGF10 (100 ng/ml).
Aspire old medium from the upper and lower chambers.
Add freshly prepared medium containing FGFs to the lower chamber only (1.5 ml per insert/well).
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator for 48 hours.
Mix conditional FAD medium with FGF2 (250 ng/ml), FGF7 (100 ng/ml), and FGF10 (100 ng/ml).
Aspire old medium from the upper and lower chambers.
Add freshly prepared medium containing FGFs to the lower chamber only (1.5 ml per insert/well).
Return the plates to the 37°C 5% CO₂ tissue culture incubator for 48 hours.
Aspire old medium from the upper and lower chambers.
Add FAD medium to the lower chamber only (1.5 ml per an insert/well).
Culture the plates for additional 14 days, changing the FAD medium three times a week in the basolateral chamber only.
On ice, combine high-concentration rat tail collagen (4mg/ml; 80% final volume) with 10xDMEM (10% final volume).
Adjust pH of the collagen mixture with 1N NaOH to 7.2 - 7.4.
Resuspend VF primary fibroblasts 2T1 cells, passage P5 - P6, in ice-cold FBS (10% final volume; 500 000 cells/ml final volume).
Add the resuspended cells to the collagen mixture.
Plate a mixture of collagen gel and VF fibroblasts on a cell culture insert, using 2 ml per a 6-well culture insert.
Let the mixture solidify for one hour in a tissue incubator at 5% CO₂, 37°C.
After one hour, gently detach the collagen with a pipette and flood the constructs with DMEM basal medium.
Return the constructs into an incubator and leave them for at least 24 hours to allow gel contraction.
Mildly trypsinize VBP in 1 or 2 days.
Plate the trypsinized VBP on collagen constructs at high density using 100 μl DMEM basal medium supplemented with FGF2 (250 ng/ml), FGF10 (100 ng/ml), and FGF7 (100 ng/ml).
Mix DMEM medium high glucose with Ham's F12 in a ratio of 1:3.
Add 2.5 ml of FBS to the mixture.
Add 0.4 mg/ml hydrocortisone to the mixture.
Add 8.4 ng/ml cholera toxin to the mixture.
Add 5 mg/ml insulin to the mixture.
Add 24 mg/ml adenine to the mixture.
Add 10 ng/ml epidermal growth factor to the mixture.
Add 1% penicillin-streptomycin to the mixture.
Apply 1 ml of FAD medium on the transwells with collagen constructs.
Apply 2 ml of FAD medium into the basolateral chamber.
Change the FAD medium every other day in submerged cultures.
Place FAD medium only in the basolateral chamber for A/Li conditions.
Change the FAD medium three times a week for A/Li conditions.
Cultivate FAD medium with human primary VFF 21T cells for 24 hours at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Collect the conditioned medium after 24 hours of cultivation.
Sterile-filter the collected medium.
Store the sterile-filtered medium at -20°C.
Mix conditional FAD medium in a ratio of 30:70 with fresh FAD medium.
